title: Storm Sorceress Ritual
description: A white-haired female sorceress in flowing robes levitates above a stormy sea, holding a glowing blue staff amid swirling magical energy and runes. In the foreground, two dark-robed spellcasters channel magic from a stone platform as a massive gothic cathedral ruin stands under a lightning-filled sky with crashing waves and shipwrecks.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a powerful white-haired sorceress with flowing white robes and hair levitating above a turbulent ocean, holding a glowing turquoise staff. She is surrounded by swirling magical energy, golden runes, and a massive vortex of water and lightning. In the foreground, two hooded spellcasters in dark ornate robes channel blue magic from a broken stone platform. Behind them looms a massive ruined gothic cathedral with rose windows under a dark stormy sky filled with lightning and heavy clouds. Shipwrecks are visible in the crashing waves.
